core_conflict_or_irony: Drivers support clean air but resent the inconvenience of leaving cars at home.
headline: Delhi announces odd-even vehicle restrictions to combat air pollution
tangible_actions: Traffic police checking number plates at intersections
Commuters switching to metro and carpools
verification_summary: Multiple wire sources confirm the Delhi government will reintroduce the odd-even vehicle rationing scheme for two weeks starting Monday.
verified_facts: Delhi government announced odd-even scheme starting Monday
Scheme applies to private four-wheelers between 8 AM and 8 PM
Two-wheelers and electric vehicles are exempt
